zh.title: 高雄國際機場（KHH）氣候韌性案例納入報告 並於聯合國氣候大會發表
zh.summary: 高雄國際機場氣候調適案例納入報告，並在聯合國氣候大會發表。
body: 交通部民用航空局表示，高雄國際機場（KHH）「打造具防災韌性的機場」實務案例獲國際永續基礎設施聯盟（ICSI）收錄於報告，並在聯合國氣候變遷大會中發表。
報告名為《氣候韌性基礎設施報告：聚焦交通》。民航局表示，機場的氣候調適工作包括強化排水滯洪與防水抗風工程。
民航局指出，2024年強颱來襲時，機場航廈與跑道均未淹水。
機場的防災體系也在國際機場協會（ACI）綠色機場評比中，獲得亞太及中東地區「氣候變遷調適」白金獎。

en.title: Kaohsiung International Airport (KHH) resilience case added to report, presented at UN climate conference
en.summary: Kaohsiung International Airport’s climate adaptation case was included in a report and presented at a UN climate conference.
body: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration said the International Coalition for Sustainable Infrastructure (ICSI) included a Kaohsiung International Airport (KHH) resilience case study in a report. The case was presented at a United Nations climate change conference.

The report is titled Climate Resilient Infrastructure Report: A Focus on Transport. The administration said the airport’s adaptation work includes strengthened drainage and flood retention, as well as waterproofing and wind-resistant works.
During a strong typhoon in 2024, the airport’s terminal and runway did not flood, according to the administration.

The airport’s disaster response system also received a platinum award for climate change adaptation in the Asia-Pacific and Middle East region in an Airports Council International (ACI) green airport assessment.
